_meta.description: Every BLS detailed occupation, grouped by the 22 SOC major groups. The app bundles this index; each continent file is loaded only when its region is opened.
_meta.aiStatus: All occupations "not yet scored". The 50 Kelley roles keep their published scores in src/data/ai_scores.json, which this dataset does not copy.

oews.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, national

topcode.text: #  = indicates a wage equal to or greater than $115.00 per hour or $239,200 per year

oews.notAvailableNote: *  = indicates that a wage estimate is not available
oews.employmentNotAvailableNote: **  = indicates that an employment estimate is not available

fieldDefinitions.TOT_EMP: Estimated total employment rounded to the nearest 10 (excludes self-employed).
fieldDefinitions.ANNUAL: Contains "TRUE" if only annual wages are released. The OEWS program releases only annual wages for some occupations that typically work fewer than 2,080 hours per year, but are paid on an annual basis, such as teachers, pilots, and athletes.
fieldDefinitions.HOURLY: Contains "TRUE" if only hourly wages are released. The OEWS program releases only hourly wages for some occupations that typically work fewer than 2,080 hours per year and are paid on an hourly basis, such as actors, dancers, and musicians and singers.
fieldDefinitions.O_GROUP: SOC occupation level. For most occupations, this field indicates the standard SOC major, minor, broad, and detailed levels, in addition to all-occupations totals. For occupations that OEWS no longer publishes at the SOC detailed level, the “detailed” designation indicates the most detailed data available: either a standard SOC broad occupation or an OEWS-specific combination of detailed occupations. Occupations that OEWS has aggregated to the SOC broad occupation level will appear in the file twice, once with the “broad” and once with the “detailed” designation.

ep.name: BLS Employment Projections, Table 1.2 Occupational projections
ep.sheetTitle: Table 1.2 Occupational projections, 2025–35, and worker characteristics, 2025 (Employment in thousands)
ep.rows: Occupation type = "Line item" for occupations; "Summary" for continents[].ep and minorGroups[].ep
ep.summaryNote: Employment subcategories do not necessarily add to higher categories due to rounding and excluded occupational data.
ep.units: employment2025, employment2035 and numericChange are persons: BLS thousands × 1000 in exact decimal arithmetic, the same units as src/data/bls_ep_2025_2035.json. percentChange is copied as published.

onet.name: O*NET Database
onet.taskRule: Tasks from the .00 code when it has task statements; otherwise from its sub-codes (each task keeps its own O*NET code; identical text kept once, alsoIn lists the other codes). Description from the .00 row.

kelley.join: kelley_title -> MAP_TITLE_TO_SOC (src/utils/onet.ts, the site's SOC) -> kelleyTracks from the CSV's track column

_meta.matching: OEWS, EP and O*NET joined on the exact SOC code only.
